about.title: About Length Converter
about.description: The Length Converter is a versatile tool for converting between various units of length and distance. From millimeters to miles, this converter handles all common length measurements used in engineering, construction, science, and everyday life. Length conversion is fundamental in many industries including construction, manufacturing, textiles, and international trade. Whether you're working on architectural plans, measuring fabric, or calculating distances, this tool ensures precise length conversions with support for both metric and imperial systems.

faq.q: What length units does the converter support?
faq.a: Our length converter supports metric units (millimeters, centimeters, meters, kilometers), imperial units (inches, feet, yards, miles), and specialized units like nautical miles, light years, and astronomical units for comprehensive distance conversion.

faq.q: How accurate are the length conversions?
faq.a: All length conversions use precise mathematical formulas with up to 15 decimal places of accuracy. This high precision makes our converter suitable for professional engineering, scientific research, and construction applications.

faq.q: What's the difference between a mile and a nautical mile?
faq.a: A statute mile equals 5,280 feet (1.609 kilometers), while a nautical mile equals 6,076 feet (1.852 kilometers). Nautical miles are used in maritime and aviation navigation because they're based on Earth's circumference.

faq.q: Can I convert very small or very large distances?
faq.a: Yes, our length converter handles everything from microscopic measurements (micrometers, nanometers) to astronomical distances (light years, parsecs) with scientific notation support for extreme values.

faq.q: How do I convert meters to feet quickly?
faq.a: To convert meters to feet, multiply by 3.28084. For example, 10 meters = 32.8084 feet. Our converter automates this calculation instantly with precise results for any length value.

faq.q: What are common length conversion factors?
faq.a: Common conversions: 1 inch = 2.54 cm, 1 foot = 30.48 cm, 1 yard = 0.9144 m, 1 mile = 1.609 km, 1 meter = 3.28084 feet. Our converter handles all these automatically.
